answer: Keep an identity's rewards small until independent evaluators validate randomly selected work against signed primary data. Detect linked keys by shared referral patterns and reused evidence; cap the whole cluster as one claimant. Reviewers might trace a ferrous sample to its assay sheet, match a forge batch to its production log, or compare a voyage's route with timestamped vessel data. A Sybil operator must fund distinct outputs and persuade separate reviewers instead of multiplying keys.
